scope: hand-generated arrays and fresh hand-assigned parameters only; no TRAIN or real model loading; no new training
required_checks: plain/legacy and hybrid gradients/updates/observed norms must pass; unconditional raw-fused mismatches are retained controls and do not become equivalence passes
hybrid_policy: observed step1/64 uses old path; empty content moments use old path; dH near-cancellation uses old path; encoder/bias mean near-cancellation falls back and bills already executed fused work
projection: retain full d2 historical base/reference, load, service/export/common cost; subtract measured read-only gradient delta from d2 observed full-update CPU; report all waves and conditional estimates
future_training: not authorized by this diagnostic; parent reviews actual cost saving before any new fixed TRAIN candidate
failure: retain every result and mismatch; do not loosen tolerances or tune weights; no automatic rerun
